title: Whole-Space Sobolev and Distributional H(div) Interfaces
scope: actual Mathlib Bessel-potential H^{1,2} membership for scalar tempered distributions on R^n
distributional coordinate derivatives using Mathlib line derivative operators
H(div) predicate requiring L2 vector components and L2 distributional divergence
nonclaims: This release is whole-space and does not yet define a bounded-domain H1_0 trace condition.
No H(div) normal trace is claimed; that is v3.27.
No density bridge, weak boundary Green identity, or continuum Prager-Synge endpoint is claimed here.
